name: Long-form draft editor
why: Edits a finished draft in passes and logs every change, the same layered method as the copy edit skill.

name: Plain English editor
why: Turns a draft into plain words with each cut explained, matching the plain language rewrite skill.

name: Revise a draft with the door open
why: A step-by-step revision of a story or book draft that marks holes and cuts, close to the structural edit.

name: Write something experts admire and newcomers enjoy
why: Trims a draft so it works for two kinds of reader, a common structural and plain language problem.

name: Honest draft feedback giver
why: Gives direct feedback on a draft, useful alongside the ranked fixes in a structural edit.

name: Anti-AI-slop copy editor
why: Fixes machine-sounding lines in copy, for drafts that were written or rewritten with AI tools.

name: Brand voice editor
why: Checks copy against a brand's voice and leaves claims untouched, the same respect for meaning an editor keeps.

name: Check a paper's claims and write a fair peer review
why: A ready workflow for the claim check, methods review and fair peer review in the academic paper review skill.

name: Draft a paper, review it and fit your journal's rules
why: Covers the review and journal-fit steps of the paper review and resubmission workflow.

name: Reviewer response progress assistant
why: Turns reviewer comments into a response matrix and revision tasks, like the reviewer response prompt.

name: Map journal reviewer requests to evidence
why: Maps each reviewer comment to the manuscript and evidence, and lists requests the author cannot answer.

name: Plain page type checker
why: Adds a type, spacing and readability check for pages, useful at the proofread stage of web copy.
